payload.detail: DEFERRED 2026-09-27 to a planned session: resolving this is a multi-file redesign of protected search chrome, not a quick fix. src/components/clinical-dashboard/master-search-header.tsx (MasterSearchHeader, about 61 props) is fed by src/components/ClinicalDashboard.tsx (56 props) and src/components/clinical-dashboard/global-search-shell.tsx (40 props). The ClinicalDashboard size itself is already tracked as a monolith in docs/maturity-backlog-workorders.md section X3. Next action: write a short design (codebase-design vocabulary) for a deeper search-session module that owns query, mode and filter state behind a small interface, agree it with the owner, then implement behind docs/search-chrome-behaviour.md with npm run verify:phone-chrome and the static contract tests.
